title: DonutSMP Money-Making Methods: A Practical Player Checklist
description: A practical checklist for evaluating DonutSMP money-making methods, building a repeatable earning loop, and choosing when to reinvest.
intro: The best DonutSMP money-making method is usually the one you can repeat under the server’s current rules. Rather than chasing a single “best” trick, use a short checklist to compare the time, risk, and starting capital each option needs.

sections.heading: Choose a repeatable method first
paragraphs: A method is only useful if you can perform it consistently. Pick one permitted activity, learn its costs, and run it enough times to understand its average return.
bullets: Prefer activities you can start with the resources you already have.
Avoid committing your full balance before you understand the selling price or demand.
Use the official server rules as the source of truth when game mechanics change.

sections.heading: Track profit instead of only revenue
paragraphs: A high sale price does not always mean a strong money-making method. Subtract the cost of materials, travel, fees, or replacement items before deciding whether an activity is worth repeating.

sections.heading: Scale through reinvestment
